📚 Hard vocab word #20: ASSIDUOUS

assiduous (adjective): showing great care and steady effort.

✅ In a sentence: Her assiduous note-taking paid off when the exam covered small details.
✅ Similar: diligent, persistent, industrious
✅ Remember it: Steady, careful, never-skip-a-day effort.
